summary: Iter 77 (display_name enhancements) verified end-to-end. Backend: 15/15 pytest cases pass on PATCH /api/cms/auth/me (401 no token; 422 missing/empty/>80; 400 whitespace-only; 200 happy path + persistence via GET /auth/me + trimming; restored to 'Garry'), POST /api/cms/admins now requires display_name (422 missing → pydantic error mentions 'display_name'; 422 empty; 200 happy path returns trimmed value + invite_url containing JWT), plus regression on change-password (401 wrong current, round-trip with token rotation, original creds restored) and delete-admin flow (self→400, unknown→404, peer→200). Frontend UI: sidebar footer shows 'Garry', /admin/account 'Your account' section renders Display name with '✏️ Edit' pill; click Edit swaps to input pre-filled with 'Garry' + Save/Cancel; change to 'Garry S.' + Save fires PATCH /auth/me, exits edit mode, shows green 'Display name updated.' toast, and sidebar footer updates to 'Garry S.' without reload; renamed back to 'Garry' (clean state). Empty-input + Save shows red 'Display name can't be empty.' toast and stays in edit mode. Escape exits edit mode with no network call. Add-admin modal has Display name FIRST with required + placeholder 'e.g. Sam Nguyen'; valid submit opens Invite Created modal. DB left clean: hello@friendplace.com.au / TestPass2026! with display_name='Garry'. All test admins deleted post-run.

issues: Empty-display-name submit does NOT surface the styled red inline error 'Please give this admin a display name so they don't show up as just "Admin".' because the HTML5 native `required` attribute on the input intercepts the submit first (browser shows its default 'Please fill out this field' tooltip instead). Functional guardrail is intact (no POST fires, modal stays open), but the friendlier custom copy from the spec never reaches the user in the primary empty-submit path. Minor UX polish — consider adding `noValidate` to the form so the JS-side validation and its warmer wording take over, or trimming the JS check to match the native tooltip. Reference: /app/website/app/admin/account/page.tsx:385-391.

action_items: (Minor UX) In InviteModal (page.tsx), the JS check `if (!displayName.trim()) setErr(...)` is masked by the native HTML5 `required` tooltip. To surface Garry's preferred warm error copy, add `noValidate` to the <form> or drop `required` on the display_name input. Fully optional — the functional guardrail (no network call on empty submit) is already correct.

(No action needed) Backend PATCH /auth/me: whitespace-only body ('   ') returns 400 (from the handler's strip check) rather than 422 (Pydantic min_length=1 lets '   ' through). Both are valid rejections; the test asserts either 400 or 422 to keep the spec resilient.
(Housekeeping) cms_module.py still exceeds 700 lines (flagged in iter 76) — no new bloat this iteration, but the extract-sub-routers cleanup is still pending.
critical_code_review_comments: PATCH /auth/me implementation is clean: narrow Pydantic model, defensive strip, no id-injection surface. `password_hash` never leaves the DB (current_cms_admin projection strips it).
InviteModal renders Display name first with autoFocus — good UX. Only nit is the native-vs-JS validation duplication called out above.
cmsApi.updateMe response shape matches the backend contract; local setAdmin() sync guarantees sidebar footer + any other consumer re-renders correctly on next paint.

success_rate.frontend: 100% functional — 1 minor UX polish note on empty-submit copy

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests: /app/backend/tests/test_iter77_display_name.py (JUnit at /app/test_reports/pytest/iter77_display_name.xml). To login the admin UI when Playwright's form handlers misbehave, POST /api/cms/auth/login and inject the returned token/admin into localStorage keys `fp_cms_token` (raw string) and `fp_cms_admin` (JSON-stringified). PATCH /api/cms/auth/me is the single write endpoint for display-name edits; GET /api/cms/auth/me is the canonical read. Backend accepts trimmed strings, rejects empty/whitespace/>80 chars, and preserves last_login_at across writes. The Add-admin invite still returns `invite_url` with a JWT reset token (~30 min TTL); the UI rewrites the host to window.location.origin for previews (verified). No changes to change-password / list-admins / delete-admin endpoints in this iter — regression suite still green.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. Only one minor UX polish item flagged (empty-invite-submit surfaces browser-native tooltip instead of the spec's warmer red inline copy, because the input has both `required` and a JS-side setErr; native validation wins the race).
